method: Behaviour cloning from four single-skill experts

expert_selection.criterion: Chosen by transition score, not by single-skill score. The full-budget handstand expert (5000 iterations) has identical solo metrics to the early one (1222 iterations) but its clone collapsed on jump->handstand (0.359 vs 0.953). The full-budget jump expert IS better solo (recovery 0.932 -> 0.970) and was kept. The shipped pair gives both: handstand transitions 0.953-1.000 from every source and jump recovery 0.969.

selection: Single policy covering walk / handstand / getup / jump with a 54-field observation (48 shared proprioceptive fields + one-hot skill + phase). Per-skill: walk 1.000 standing with 0.063 m/s tracking error, handstand 0.971, getup 0.961, jump 0.074 m peak rise with 0.969 recovery. Mean off-diagonal transition success 0.943, up from 0.929 (early experts only) and 0.873 (full-budget handstand expert). Two PPO fine-tunes (LR 3e-4 x 1900 and LR 5e-5 x 900) were measured and rejected: 0.916 and 0.865 on transitions. See docs/opendoge_multiskill.md.
